title: Final answer correctness
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the time from radius 2r to 3r must be (5/3)T or an equivalent expression.

title: Proportionality principle application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly state or apply that the time taken is proportional to the increase in cross-sectional area of the steel plate roll.

title: Area difference calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the area differences for the two intervals (e.g., π(2r)^2 - πr^2 and π(3r)^2 - π(2r)^2).

title: Ratio setup and simplification
description: Important Criteria: The solution must set up the correct ratio of times based on the proportional area increases and simplify it to find the unknown time.

title: Constant speed recognition
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may explicitly note that the linear rolling speed is constant, linking length rolled to time.

title: Incorrect area formula
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses circumference or perimeter instead of cross-sectional area in the proportionality.

title: Algebraic or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize for mistakes in squaring radii, subtracting areas, or simplifying the ratio (e.g., 9-4=5 and 4-1=3 leading to 5/3).
